definitions.gloss: stray dog; feral dog; wild dog
definitions.explanation: A dog living without an owner, roaming freely in the wild or in urban areas. Includes both abandoned domestic dogs and those born in the wild.

examples.japanese: {公園|こうえん}で{野犬|やけん}を{見|み}かけた。
examples.english: I spotted a stray dog in the park.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}では{野犬|やけん}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Stray dogs are increasing in this area.

examples.japanese: {野犬|やけん}に{近|ちか}づくのは{危険|きけん}なので、{見|み}つけたら{保健所|ほけんじょ}に{連絡|れんらく}してください。
examples.english: Approaching stray dogs is dangerous, so if you find one, please contact the public health center.

notes: Also sometimes read as のいぬ, though やけん is the standard reading. Common collocations include {野犬|やけん}{狩|が}り (rounding up stray dogs) and {野犬|やけん}の{群|む}れ (a pack of stray dogs). Compare with {野良犬|のらいぬ} (stray dog, more colloquial) and {捨|す}て{犬|いぬ} (abandoned dog). In Japan, stray dogs are managed by {保健所|ほけんじょ} (public health centers) and {動物愛護|どうぶつあいご}センター (animal welfare centers).
